headline: Cal State LA yet to concede after three wins
dek: Cal State LA have won all three of their matches without conceding a goal, and Abraham Ramirez has made thirteen saves behind them for three shutouts. Every other unbeaten side in the conference has already been scored on.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Fresno Pacific's fourteen goals have come from five different scorers, and the total is more than Cal State San Bernardino, Cal State East Bay, UC Merced and Menlo have scored between them.

wire.line: UC Merced have played three matches and drawn every one of them.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Ten matches have passed their date with no result recorded, the earliest on the season's opening day and the latest in August. No final is missing its score.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: One match with a published result has no box score behind it: Fresno Pacific's win at Pacific in August, for which no collected schedule page carried a link.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Cal State East Bay have conceded ten goals, more than any other programme, and have yet to win.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Chico State have lost all three matches counted to their record, and their home match against Saint Martin's carries a result the source marks as disputed.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Alexis Cervantes has taken fifteen shots for Stanislaus State and scored three times.

last_match.line: Fresno Pacific have still not won at home this season; Dominican have drawn on every CCAA ground they have visited but one.

next_match.line: Cal State East Bay are yet to win; Cal State Monterey Bay have won every match they have played but conceded in each of them.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
